question: Can any single cue-to-motor chemical edge strength, scaled within 0.5x-4x of the parent and under an explicit widened engineering prior, produce at least 1% cue-on motion reduction in every body region while preserving baseline gait and recovery?
motivation: E093/E094 reached 0.04-0.11% reduction. E094 details: AWA depolarizes ~2.5 mV but AIYR/AIYL move ~0.1/0.01 mV; AIYL release is saturated (0.979); RIAR release is ~0.009; AWAR->AIYR and AIBR->AIYR moved to within ~12%/9% of their original upper caps.
method: No optimizer. One evaluation per (edge, factor): a single chemical edge multiplied by the factor, all else equal to the parent, nominal protocol, target 1%, margin 1. Unit-factor control is the pinned parent reproduction. Then the two cases with the largest weakest-region reduction among gait-and-recovery-preserving cases are re-run with raw traces plus neural-half, body-half and sensory-blocked controls.
parent: Same audited unique passing E092 isolated 1.25 AIYR->AIYL panel as E093/E094; hash pinned at runtime in the new input manifest, not invented here.
skipped_rule: Factors that would go below the original lower bound are skipped and recorded, never widened.
prior_exception: E092 AIYR->AIYL one-edge exception retained. Each scanned edge may exceed its original upper bound up to 4x the parent strength. This is an engineering prior, not measured biology; no scanned edge is admitted as a global standard.
fixed: All other densities/strengths/gaps, topology/signs, reversals, leak, kinetics, release law, sensory gains, NMJ/muscle/body/water physics and physical clocks.

budget.workers: 8 x 4 physical cores if >=32 available else 4 x 4

acceptance_criteria.informative_route: A finalist with all three regional reductions >= 1%, safe, baseline and recovery preserved, same checkpoint across its four controls, neural/body half-grid differences <= 0.25 x target (0.25%), and sensory-blocked ratios within 0.25% of 1 with relay change <= 5e-6.
acceptance_criteria.negative: No case reaches 1% in all regions, or finalist controls fail. This would show that none of the scanned single edges, even widened, supplies enough cue gain.
acceptance_criteria.scan_cases: Metrics-only. The scan is a diagnostic; a passing case is not a fitted or qualified model.

audit: scripts.audit_edge_scan runs automatically inside the budget: input/trace hashes, decode of every z, single-changed-edge and frozen-field checks, widened-prior use, retained-trace feature and score recomputation, finalist ranking and rerun consistency.
claims_not_made: No fitting, component qualification, initial sensory initiation, full start/stop, swimming or biological validation.
